description: Repository class for managing organization routing forms and responses, including methods for fetching and updating routing form data with filtering options.

classes.name: OrganizationsRoutingFormsRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to interact with organization routing forms and responses in the database.

methods.name: getOrganizationRoutingForms
methods.description: Fetches routing forms for an organization with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getOrganizationRoutingFormResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a specific routing form within an organization, with optional filters.

methods.name: updateRoutingFormResponse
methods.description: Updates a specific routing form response with new data.
